scripts.text: A stranger. This place is supposed to be for Eden Group Members only.
scripts.translation: 陌生人？這裡只對樂園團成員開放。

scripts.text: I'm in need base level ^FF0000111 - 120^000000 adventurers to help my research.
scripts.translation: 我需要基礎等級^FF0000111～120^000000的冒險者幫我進行研究。

scripts.text: The Geneticist is muttering to herself.
scripts.translation: 那位基因學者正在自言自語。

scripts.text: Thou art not? Splendid...because I deigned that any servant of mine would have more dignity.
scripts.translation: 你不是？太好了...因為我覺得我的僕人理應更有尊嚴。

scripts.text: Well, non-servant...What are you looking for here?
scripts.translation: 那麼，不是僕人的你...來這裡想找什麼？

scripts.text: That is acceptable, I hope ye find what ye seek.
scripts.translation: 可以。希望你能找到想要的東西。

scripts.text: Oh me? I am ^E51BD8Busaner Mingmin^000000 and I'm researching monsters by request of the Eden Group.
scripts.translation: 哦？我叫^E51BD8布薩納·明敏^000000，受樂園團委托研究魔物。

scripts.text: I used to collect fungus and mold alone at my mountain lab. Since then, I joined a group looking for new monsters...
scripts.translation: 以前我獨自在山間實驗室收集菌類和黴菌。後來，我加入了一個尋找新魔物的團體...

scripts.text: With all my experience, they actually made me a professor here at the Eden Group.
scripts.translation: 憑著多年的經驗，他們竟然讓我在樂園團擔任教授。

scripts.text: Anyways, there is a pressing task I must complete, please excuse me for a moment.
scripts.translation: 總之，我有一件急事要處理，失陪一下。

scripts.text: ^0C0CF2Pop quiz hot shot: Art thou my servant?^000000
scripts.translation: ^0C0CF2小測驗，大人物：你是我的僕人嗎？^000000

scripts.text: Oh I have met you before, living in a house full of fungus seems to cause memory loss.
scripts.translation: 哦，我見過你。在滿是菌類的房子裡住久了，記憶力好像會變差。

scripts.text: I am collecting information on the flora and fauna of Midgard for the Eden Group.
scripts.translation: 我正在為樂園團收集米德加爾特大陸動植物的資料。

scripts.text: The intention is to scientifically catalog and itemize the dangers of the world. I do not like this idea personally.
scripts.translation: 他們想用科學方法編目整理這個世界的危險生物。我個人並不喜歡這個想法。

scripts.text: Theory will only take you so far in this world.
scripts.translation: 理論在這個世界上終究有其侷限。

scripts.text: Morever, an adventurer who travelled outside of Rune-Midgarts should be experienced enough to know themselves.
scripts.translation: 而且，去過盧恩·米德加茲王國以外地方的冒險者，應該已經足夠了解自己了。

scripts.text: This is ^ff0000my opinion^000000 only so do not concern thyself.
scripts.translation: 這只是^ff0000我個人的看法^000000，別放在心上。

scripts.text: Well, after all this talking I need to take a rest. My feet are rather tired.
scripts.translation: 說了這麼多，我得休息一會兒。我腳有點累了。

scripts.text: Oh, {0} its you... it is good you have ed, I was bored.
scripts.translation: 哦，是你啊，{0}...你回來得正好，我都快無聊死了。

scripts.text: Where was I? I just finished talking about the Eden Group's duty to protect others from danger.
scripts.translation: 我說到哪兒了？剛才說完樂園團保護大家免受危險的職責。

scripts.text: To protect more people, I think they need adventurers who have experienced things first-hand.
scripts.translation: 我覺得，為了保護更多人，他們需要有親身經歷的冒險者。

scripts.text: So we need those brave or foolhardy enough to venture out to gather info in the field.
scripts.translation: 所以我們需要那些勇敢，或者說膽大包天，敢到野外收集情報的人。

scripts.text: Sounds dangerous... when can I start?
scripts.translation: 聽起來很危險...我什麼時候能開始？

scripts.text: Talk to me in a second and we'll get going.
scripts.translation: 等一下再來找我，我們就出發。

scripts.text: Question {0}! I was practising because new servant is coming soon.
scripts.translation: 第{0}題！我正在練習，因為新僕人馬上就要來了。
你說的新僕人是什麼意思？
哦...抱歉，我是說見習騎士...

scripts.text: Sorry, the fungus in my home has been getting quite rampant.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我家裡的菌類最近長得太猖獗了。

scripts.text: I found Rohtert is working here when I arrived with a request from Eden Group.
scripts.translation: 我接到樂園團的委託來到這裡時，發現羅特特也在這裡工作。

scripts.text: Thou has met him prior to now? I do have a history with him.
scripts.translation: 你以前見過他嗎？我和他有些交情。

scripts.text: The guy with white hair by the entrance. You should drop by if you are interested, he is managing level 100-110 adventurers.
scripts.translation: 入口旁那個白頭髮的傢伙。你有興趣的話可以去找他，他負責管理基礎等級100～110的冒險者。

scripts.text: Anyways, he had been working here so he knows better than me. I just came by to get advice.
scripts.translation: 總之，他一直在這裡工作，比我更熟悉情況。我只是來向他請教。

scripts.text: That was not that difficult so..
Silly adventurers are going to come and ask me, ^ff0000'My queen, treat me like a naughty servant!'^000000
scripts.translation: 那些傻冒險者就會跑來問我：^ff0000“女王大人，請把我當成壞僕人來管教！”^000000

scripts.text: For some reason there aren't many people lining up to assist me yet.
scripts.translation: 不知為何，目前排隊來幫我的人不多。

scripts.text: I think it requires ^ff0000bravery^000000 to take a new request.
scripts.translation: 接受新的委託需要^ff0000勇氣^000000。

scripts.text: Enough dilly-dallying, I want to make a contract with someone who really craves adventure.
scripts.translation: 別再磨蹭了，我想找個真正渴望冒險的人簽訂契約。

scripts.text: Maybe {0} I'll let you be my servant if you are interested in doing this Eden Group request for my research.
scripts.translation: 也許我可以讓{0}當我的僕人...如果你願意接下這份樂園團研究委託的話。

scripts.text: I think I already told you that I am looking for an adventurer with more experience for my monster research.
scripts.translation: 我想我已經告訴過你，我在尋找經驗更豐富的冒險者，協助我研究魔物。

scripts.text: It is because this mission has very dangerous requests.
scripts.translation: 因為這項任務的委託都非常危險。

scripts.text: Lets see. If you can handle all requests from rohtert standing there, then I will reconsider.
scripts.translation: 這樣吧，如果你能完成那邊羅特特交給你的所有委託，我會重新考慮。

scripts.text: I will reconsider if you turn to base level 111.
scripts.translation: 等你的基礎等級升到111級，我會重新考慮。

scripts.text: Oh, you want to help me with my research?
She seems to be waiting for a ^FF0000special signal.^000000 What do you want to do?
scripts.translation: 她似乎在等一個^FF0000特別訊號^000000。你想怎麼做？

scripts.text: Make a heart with two hands.
Dance around like a crazy person
Hmm, she didn't go for that.
Well, that's all settled then! Thou shalt signeth this form.
scripts.translation: 好，就這麼說定了！你要簽下這份檔案。

scripts.text: A - adventurer shall not talk back to Busaner Mingmin and will not complain under any circumstance.
scripts.translation: A - 冒險者不得頂撞布薩納·明敏，也不得在任何情況下抱怨。

scripts.text: B - adventurer shall proceed to complete the request for Busaner Mingmin as quick as humanly possible.
scripts.translation: B - 冒險者必須儘可能迅速地完成布薩納·明敏交付的委託。

scripts.text: C -This contract is terminated on the day that a request of the adventurer is completed.
scripts.translation: C - 冒險者完成委託之日，本合同即告終止。

scripts.text: D - this contract shall be confidential except between the adventurer and Mingmin under ^FF0000penalty of death.^000000
scripts.translation: D - 除冒險者與明敏之外，任何人不得知曉本合同，違者將受^FF0000死刑處罰^000000。

scripts.text: Don't worry too much. The Unions require it you know. Just sign on the line that is dotted.
scripts.translation: 不用太擔心。公會都要求籤這個，你知道的。只要在虛線上簽名就行。

scripts.text: Haha! I feel much better now.
Thank you for accepting the strange contract. Looking forward to working with thee.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你接受這份奇怪的合同。期待與你合作。

scripts.text: I was careful for public requests because I have to be polite to adventurers.
scripts.translation: 公開委託時，我會注意禮貌，因為必須客氣地對待冒險者。

scripts.text: I tried to be poilte . But it just doesn't suit my personality.
scripts.translation: 我努力過了。但禮貌實在不符合我的個性。

scripts.text: Thou shouldst be more careful...Did you notice something about the pen you signed with? There were ^FF0000orange shiitake mushroom spores^000000 on it.
scripts.translation: 你該小心點...注意到你簽字用的筆有什麼問題了嗎？上面沾有^FF0000橙色香菇孢子^000000。

scripts.text: If the spores get in your bloodstream, you might grow mushrooms inside of your own body.
scripts.translation: 孢子要是進入你的血液，你的身體裡可能會長出蘑菇。

scripts.text: It takes quite a long time so do thine best. I might give you the antidote if you do well.
scripts.translation: 這需要相當長的時間，所以盡力而為吧。表現好的話，我或許會給你解藥。

scripts.text: All right we became quite familiar now. So. Shall we get start to work?
scripts.translation: 好了，我們現在已經熟悉多了。那麼，開始工作吧？

scripts.text: We need some more information on the following monsters. Choose.
scripts.translation: 我們需要更多關於以下魔物的資料。請選擇。

scripts.text: I heard something is going on in Glastheim. Monsters are afoot.
scripts.translation: 我聽說葛拉斯特海姆出事了，那裡出現了魔物。

scripts.text: Raydric's research is going well. It is better off having more samples to research.!
scripts.translation: 幽靈劍士的研究進展順利。要是能多收集些樣本就更好了！

scripts.text: You can find Raydric in the west entrance or on the 2nd floor of Glastheim.
scripts.translation: 你可以在葛拉斯特海姆西側入口或二樓找到幽靈劍士。

scripts.text: I need information and document no matter what happens. Come back to me after dealing with ^FF000030 Raydric^000000's.
scripts.translation: 無論如何，我都需要資料和檔案。擊敗^FF000030只幽靈劍士^000000後再來找我。

scripts.text: The experience you learn by fighting with monsters will be a good record for the research!
scripts.translation: 你與魔物戰鬥獲得的經驗，也能成為研究的寶貴記錄！

scripts.text: How do you feel dealing with tough monsters? Good documents and good experience to you as well.
scripts.translation: 和強大的魔物戰鬥感覺如何？你能獲得不錯的資料和經驗。

scripts.text: Something is happening in Glastheim. And that clue is in Raydrics that is information I have.
scripts.translation: 葛拉斯特海姆似乎發生了什麼事。我掌握的線索都指向幽靈劍士。

scripts.text: I need information and document no matter what happens. Come back to me after dealing with ^FF000030 Raydric^000000's.
scripts.translation: 無論如何，我都需要資料和檔案。擊敗^FF000030只幽靈劍士^000000後再來找我。

scripts.text: Please come back to me after dealing with the monsters. I need all your stories for documentation.
scripts.translation: 擊敗那些魔物後請回來。我需要你講述的所有經歷，作為研究記錄。

scripts.text: Khalitzburg's research is going well. It is better off having more samples to research!
scripts.translation: 卡利斯格的研究進展順利。要是能多收集些樣本就更好了！

scripts.text: Khalitzburg will be found in west entrance of Glastheim.
scripts.translation: 在葛拉斯特海姆西側入口可以找到卡利斯格。

scripts.text: I need information and document no matter what happens. Come back to me after dealing with ^FF000030 Khalitzburg's^000000
scripts.translation: 無論如何，我都需要資料和檔案。擊敗^FF000030只卡利斯格^000000後再來找我。

scripts.text: The experience you learn by fighting with monsters will be a good record for the research!
scripts.translation: 你與魔物戰鬥獲得的經驗，也能成為研究的寶貴記錄！

scripts.text: How do you feel of dealing with tough monsters? Good documents and good experience to you as well.
scripts.translation: 和強大的魔物戰鬥感覺如何？你能獲得不錯的資料和經驗。

scripts.text: Maybe Khalitzburg is linked to what is happening in glastheim so lets research it.
scripts.translation: 也許卡利斯格和葛拉斯特海姆發生的事有關，我們來研究一下吧。

scripts.text: I need information and document no matter what happens. Come back to me after dealing with ^FF000030 Khalitzburg's^000000
scripts.translation: 無論如何，我都需要資料和檔案。擊敗^FF000030只卡利斯格^000000後再來找我。

scripts.text: Please tell me the story after dealing with them one by one. They will be important documents...
scripts.translation: 請逐一告訴我戰鬥經歷，這些都是重要的研究資料...

scripts.text: Wanderer's research is going well. It is better off having more samples to research!
scripts.translation: 邪骸浪人的研究進展順利。要是能多收集些樣本就更好了！

scripts.text: Wanderer will be found if you enter from the north entrance and go to big entrance in the middle of the road in Glastheim.
scripts.translation: 進入葛拉斯特海姆後，從北側入口一路走到道路中央的大門，就能找到邪骸浪人。

scripts.text: I need information and documents no matter what happens. How about dealing with ^FF000030 Wanderers^000000.
scripts.translation: 無論如何，我都需要資料。要不要去對付^FF000030只邪骸浪人^000000？

scripts.text: The experience you learn by fighting with monsters will be a good record for the research!
scripts.translation: 你與魔物戰鬥獲得的經驗，也能成為研究的寶貴記錄！

scripts.text: How do you feel of dealing with tough monsters? Good documents and good experience to you as well.
scripts.translation: 和強大的魔物戰鬥感覺如何？你能獲得不錯的資料和經驗。

scripts.text: Wanderer is the representative of Glastheim. It is dangerous but cool!
scripts.translation: 邪骸浪人是葛拉斯特海姆的代表魔物，危險卻很帥氣！

scripts.text: It will be a good research. Come back after dealing with ^FF000030 Wanderers^000000.
scripts.translation: 這會是很有價值的研究。擊敗^FF000030只邪骸浪人^000000後再回來。

scripts.text: Please tell me the story after dealing with them one by one. They will be important documents...
scripts.translation: 請逐一告訴我戰鬥經歷，這些都是重要的研究資料...

scripts.text: We need to research monsters in Thanatos tower.
scripts.translation: 我們需要研究達納托斯塔的魔物。

scripts.text: Ancient mimic research is going well. It is better off having more samples for the research!
scripts.translation: 狂暴邪惡箱的研究進展順利。要是能多收集些樣本就更好了！

scripts.text: It is not far if you move from Juno or Hugel to Thanatos or Abyss lake.
scripts.translation: 從朱諾或毀葛前往達納托斯塔或毀葛深淵湖水都不遠。

scripts.text: Do not complain! It will be a good experience for you!
scripts.translation: 別抱怨！這會是很好的經驗！

scripts.text: The experience you learn by fighting with monsters will be a good record to research!
scripts.translation: 你與魔物戰鬥獲得的經驗，也能成為研究的寶貴記錄！

scripts.text: You will see them often at thanatos tower or abyss lake. They are not generous with their drops but that is not important to finishing this request.
scripts.translation: 在達納托斯塔或毀葛深淵湖水經常能看到它們。它們不太會掉落物品，不過這不影響完成委託。

scripts.text: I can not find any connection in two areas but they keep coming up so it is worth researching. Come back after taking care of ^FF000030 ancient mimic^000000.
scripts.translation: 我找不到這兩個地方之間有什麼聯絡，不過這些魔物總是出現，值得研究。擊敗^FF000030只狂暴邪惡箱^000000後再回來。

scripts.text: If you possibly get a good drop from them, you know right? Do not forget about me!
scripts.translation: 如果它們掉了什麼好東西，你懂的吧？別忘了我！

scripts.text: Deathword's research is going well. It is better off having more samples for the research!
scripts.translation: 死靈書的研究進展順利。要是能多收集些樣本就更好了！

scripts.text: Thanatos tower will be more dangerous than you thought. You might want to organize a party before going there.
scripts.translation: 達納托斯塔會比你想像的更危險。去之前最好先組隊。

scripts.text: I want to research this so take this request please!
scripts.translation: 我想研究這個，請接下這份委託！

scripts.text: I will give you a reward...
Thank you so much. This will be great research.
scripts.translation: 太感謝你了。這些資料對研究很有幫助。

scripts.text: That is the reason why I chose Thanatos tower to research. Do not be surprised. This one is an old book that became a monster!
scripts.translation: 所以我才選擇研究達納托斯塔。別驚訝，這可是一本變成魔物的古書！

scripts.text: I want to research the background of those creatures. Please check ^FF000030 Deathwords^000000.
scripts.translation: 我想調查這些魔物的來歷。請去對付^FF000030只死靈書^000000。

scripts.text: Please take care of them one by one. Those books contain precious history of Midgard so I want to research them.
scripts.translation: 請逐一處理它們。這些書裡記載著米德加爾特的珍貴歷史，我想好好研究。

scripts.text: Owl Baron's research is going well. It is better off having more samples for the research!
scripts.translation: 鶚梟男爵的研究進展順利。要是能多收集些樣本就更好了！

scripts.text: You can meet it if you climb the tower according to the rumors. For me, well I've never been up there.
scripts.translation: 聽說沿著塔往上爬就能遇見它。至於我嘛，我從來沒上去過。

scripts.text: The guy with blue hat went to the top but I didn't bother to follow.
scripts.translation: 那個戴藍帽子的傢伙去了頂層，不過我懶得跟去。

scripts.text: Anyways, There will be enough reward for sure.
Safely back!? Eden Group will be happy.
scripts.translation: 你平安回來了！？樂園團會很高興的。

scripts.text: Personally I have no interest in this monster but it was requested from the Eden Group.
scripts.translation: 我個人對這種魔物沒興趣，不過這是樂園團委托的。

scripts.text: Please take care of ^FF000020 Owl Barons^000000. It will help other adventurers to explore Thanatos tower.
scripts.translation: 請幫忙處理^FF000020只鶚梟男爵^000000，這能幫助其他冒險者探索達納托斯塔。

scripts.text: It does not mean I am not going to research them. The more documents the better research.
scripts.translation: 這並不代表我不研究它們。資料越多，研究就越完善。

scripts.text: I like old books! Okay I need to analyze this. Bloody Pages! Please bring more tomorrow or the day after tomorrow. Anytime!
scripts.translation: 我喜歡古書！好了，我得分析一下這些染血的書頁。明天或後天再多帶些來，什麼時候都行！

scripts.text: Wow. It is so curious. It is exciting!
scripts.translation: 哇，真奇妙！太令人興奮了！

scripts.text: 3rd floor of thanatos has Deathword monsers that drop these bloody pages.
scripts.translation: 達納托斯塔三樓的死靈書魔物會掉落這些染血的書頁。

scripts.text: I think if thou shalt collect 20 of these it should be enough for my research. It's barbaric, but it is a job!
scripts.translation: 我想你收集20張就足夠我研究了。雖然這工作有點野蠻，但也是工作！

scripts.text: There will be enough reward for sure.
The fact that I decided to travel to Thanatos has the reason. Haha, I heard that I can get Bloody Pages from Deathword monsters.
scripts.translation: 我決定來達納托斯塔當然是有原因的。哈哈，我聽說死靈書會掉落染血的書頁。

scripts.text: I know they're gross and bloody but just imagine the centuries of stories preserved in those pages...
scripts.translation: 我知道那些書頁又髒又帶血，不過想想看，裡面儲存著數百年的故事...

scripts.text: Can you please get me 20 ^FF0000Bloody Pages^000000? I will be happy if there is one useful bookshelf we can use when you bring them back.
scripts.translation: 能幫我找20張^FF0000染血的書頁^000000嗎？如果能找到有用的書架帶回來，我會很高興。

scripts.text: Please, I really want to research this.
scripts.translation: 拜託了，我真的很想研究這個。

scripts.text: The research for Ash Vacuum is just beginning. So there are still many thing to study!
scripts.translation: 灰燼之地的研究才剛剛開始，還有很多事情要調查！
研究沉醉於魔力的捕蟲堇妖
研究沉醉於魔力的那迦

scripts.text: We know the magic power of the horn we saw that day.
scripts.translation: 我們知道那天見到的角蘊含著魔力。

scripts.text: Pinguicula dark's research is ongoing. Please come back to me next time.!
scripts.translation: 暗黑捕蟲堇的研究還在進行中。下次再來找我吧！

scripts.text: I think this research is easy. They are not too dangerous from the initial reports I've received.
scripts.translation: 我想這項研究比較簡單。根據最初收到的報告，它們不算太危險。

scripts.text: It is north west from the Allied Forces Camp. It is not that far so hurry up.
scripts.translation: 它就在聯合軍營地的西北方，距離不遠，快去吧。

scripts.text: Good job! keep helping my research. I still have so much to do.
scripts.translation: 幹得好！繼續幫我做研究吧，我還有好多事要做。

scripts.text: It is the monster living northwest of the Allied Forces Camp. I am not interested in going myself but the request was already paid for and I may as well research them.
scripts.translation: 這種魔物住在聯合軍營地的西北方。我對親自前往沒興趣，不過委託已經付過報酬，正好可以研究一下。

scripts.text: Hunt ^FF000030 Dark Pinguicula^000000. Battling it will provide some good research materials.
scripts.translation: 狩獵^FF000030只沉醉於魔力的捕蟲堇妖^000000。與它戰鬥能提供不錯的研究材料。

scripts.text: Nepenthes's research is still ongoing. Please come back to me next time!
scripts.translation: 豬籠草的研究還在繼續。下次再來找我吧！

scripts.text: It could be a simple request or tough request. Try to find friends if you are in trouble. That is adventure too!
scripts.translation: 這項委託可能很簡單，也可能很棘手。遇到困難就找朋友幫忙，這也是冒險的一部分！

scripts.text: It is east of the Allied Forces Camp. It is not that far so hurry up.
scripts.translation: 它在聯合軍營地的東邊，距離不遠，快去吧。

scripts.text: Good job! Keep assisting with my research. I still have so much to do.
scripts.translation: 幹得好！繼續協助我的研究吧，我還有好多事要做。

scripts.text: Do you know the monster name as mandragora? There is similar monster to the east of the expedition station. I am sure it will be related for researching monsters.
scripts.translation: 你知道曼陀羅魔花嗎？遠征隊營地東邊有一種類似的魔物。我想它們與魔物研究有關。

scripts.text: Why don't you hunt 30 ^FF0000Nepenthes^000000? Their vines crawl up everywhere so be careful.
scripts.translation: 去狩獵30只^FF0000豬籠草^000000好嗎？它們的藤蔓到處攀爬，小心點。

scripts.text: The request like this satisfies me and the Eden Group. Be careful though.
scripts.translation: 這樣的委託讓我和樂園團都很滿意。不過要小心。

scripts.text: Naga's research is still ongoing. Please come back to me next time.
scripts.translation: 那迦的研究還在繼續。下次再來找我吧！

scripts.text: You take care of those addicted to magic powers, I have no interest.
scripts.translation: 你去照料那些沉醉於魔力的魔物吧，我對此沒興趣。

scripts.text: Please take care of 30 Naga monsters northwest of the expedition station.
scripts.translation: 請去遠征隊營地西北方處理30只那迦。

scripts.text: Good. Keep helping my research. I have too many to check out.
scripts.translation: 很好，繼續協助我的研究吧，我還有許多魔物要調查。

scripts.text: Please take care of 30 ^FF0000Naga^000000 monsters northwest of the expedition station.
scripts.translation: 請去遠征隊營地西北方處理30只^FF0000那迦^000000。

scripts.text: I have no interest in it but it bothers my time to research the other monsters that I actually want to study. So I want the number of them to be reduced.
scripts.translation: 我對它沒興趣，但它妨礙我研究其他真正想調查的魔物。所以我希望減少它們的數量。

scripts.text: Please do your best. This request is also important to unlock additional research.
scripts.translation: 請盡力完成這項委託。它對解鎖後續研究也很重要。

scripts.text: I'm still researching the Centipede Larva. Please come and help me next time.
scripts.translation: 我還在研究變異蜈蚣幼蟲。下次來幫幫我吧。

scripts.text: Oh... No Lets take a deep breath. For me, I want to exterminate more than 20 for research.
scripts.translation: 呃...不，先深呼吸。為了研究，我想消滅20只以上。

scripts.text: Be careful. And they're east of the expedition station.
scripts.translation: 小心。它們在遠征隊營地東邊。

scripts.text: Oh. Okay. You do not need to explain.
Yuck! It is very disgusting. Look at me. It is so creepy I wanted to survey it because I was interested in Nepenthes. But I hate bugs with lots of legs...
scripts.translation: 噁心死了！看我，我覺得它太可怕了。本來我對豬籠草感興趣才想調查它，可我最討厭這種長著好多條腿的蟲子...

scripts.text: Come back after 20 ^FF0000Centipede Larva^000000 are exterminated. Can you imagine how big they became? Just the thought makes my skin crawl.
scripts.translation: 請消滅20只^FF0000變異蜈蚣幼蟲^000000後再回來。想像一下它們長大後的樣子，光是想到就讓我起雞皮疙瘩。

scripts.text: I'm sorry that I didn't do it myself. I'm not ashamed to admit that it's too disgusting for me.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我沒親自去做。我不怕承認，這實在太噁心了。

scripts.text: Cornus's research is still ongoing. Please research for other adventurers.
scripts.translation: 飛馬的研究還在繼續。請繼續為其他冒險者調查吧。

scripts.text: I need to research those flying horse creatures so please help me out.
scripts.translation: 我需要研究那些會飛的馬形生物，幫幫我吧。

scripts.text: Of course, It will help your adventurers too in some way I suppose.
scripts.translation: 當然，這多少也能幫到冒險者。

scripts.text: How was it ? Is that monster easy for adventurers to get?
scripts.translation: 情況怎麼樣？冒險者容易找到那種魔物嗎？

scripts.text: I found the monster that satisfies my research needs and helps adventurers to gain experience from the Eden Group. It is not weak or fierce monster either.
scripts.translation: 我找到了一種既符合我的研究需求，又能讓樂園團冒險者獲得經驗的魔物。它既不弱，也不兇猛。

scripts.text: I believe that Adventurers will handle Cornus in the future, so go out and deal with ^FF000030 Cornus^000000 so I can research that viability.
scripts.translation: 我想冒險者今後會處理飛馬，所以請去對付^FF000030只飛馬^000000，讓我研究一下這種安排是否可行。

scripts.text: This could be a revolution for Eden Group Adventurers. Be positive with this request please.
scripts.translation: 這項研究可能會改變樂園團冒險者的未來，請積極完成這份委託。

scripts.text: I'm still researching the Mystic Horns you brought. Quite interesting. I can beat blue hat soon.
scripts.translation: 我還在研究你帶來的魔力之角。真有意思。我很快就能打敗那個藍帽子了。

scripts.text: Yes this one! It is worth doing. Thank you for taking this request.
scripts.translation: 就是這個！這件事值得做。謝謝你接下這份委託。

scripts.text: I am still researching but I hope to extract magic power from magical touched things.
scripts.translation: 我還在研究，希望能從受到魔力影響的物品中提取魔力。

scripts.text: It will be useful for me and adventurers, right?
scripts.translation: 這對我和冒險者都有幫助，對吧？

scripts.text: This is why I accepted the request for this from Eden Group. Find 20 ^FF0000Mystic Horn^000000 from the Cornus monsters.
scripts.translation: 所以我才接受了樂園團的委託。去飛馬身上找20個^FF0000魔力之角^000000。

scripts.text: I think I can use this horn for good things. It is easy to get. I will let you know later.
scripts.translation: 我想這隻角能派上用場。它不難取得，以後再告訴你詳情。

scripts.text: Ye gain experience and I get research material. Good deal right? Excellent!
scripts.translation: 你獲得經驗，我得到研究材料。很划算吧？太好了！

scripts.text: This request is for my personal research. I research for Eden Group and they support me to hire people assisting my research.
scripts.translation: 這是我個人的研究。我替樂園團做研究，他們則資助我僱人幫忙。
收集碎片與生鏽的螺絲

scripts.text: Ancient Mummy's research is still ongoing.
scripts.translation: 狂暴木乃伊的研究還在繼續。

scripts.text: If I finish researching, the first thing I'm going to do is eat a 10 year aged strawberry pudding...
scripts.translation: 等研究結束後，我第一件事就是吃一份陳釀十年的草莓布丁...

scripts.text: To finish my research I need you to hunt some Ancient Mummy.
scripts.translation: 為了完成研究，我需要你去狩獵一些狂暴木乃伊。

scripts.text: Did a good job. Fantastic strawberry pudding is not easy to make. Trust me. I will let thee taste it someday soon.
scripts.translation: 幹得好！美味的草莓布丁可不容易做。相信我，改天一定讓你嚐嚐。

scripts.text: Things are supposed to go bad. Most of them but people want to keep and preserve food for a long time.
scripts.translation: 東西總會變質。人們卻想讓食物儲存很久，所以大多會想辦法保鮮。

scripts.text: Have you even seen the bandage that Ancient Mummy are wound up in? They last even for centuries at a time.
scripts.translation: 你見過狂暴木乃伊身上的繃帶嗎？它們甚至能儲存好幾個世紀。

scripts.text: I guess it is rotten but we can make big money if this research goes well. Preservatives can make a strawberry pudding that does not go bad with time.
scripts.translation: 我想那些東西已經腐爛了，不過研究成功的話，我們就能賺大錢。防腐劑或許能讓草莓布丁長久不壞。

scripts.text: This research is necessary so that I can make my strawberry pudding.
scripts.translation: 為了製作我的草莓布丁，這項研究必不可少。

scripts.text: Geffenia's research has just started. It is beginning so go slowly. Lets research.
scripts.translation: 葛帔尼亞的研究才剛開始，慢慢來，一步步研究吧。

scripts.text: I do not expect a lot because it is very dangerous and not easy to access.
scripts.translation: 那裡非常危險，也不容易進入，所以我不抱太大期望。

scripts.text: This request is attempting to an adventurer who used to enjoy it. Simple! Fun! Worthy experience!
scripts.translation: 這份委託是想找一位以前樂在其中的冒險者。簡單、有趣，還能獲得不錯的經驗！

scripts.text: You are more talented than I thought. If you found a tact, I will request to you for next time as well. This research is up to you.
scripts.translation: 你比我想的更有本事。如果你找到了訣竅，下次我還會委託你。這項研究就交給你了。

scripts.text: This is pre-survey for precious research because Geffenia is easy to access.
scripts.translation: 這是重要研究前的初步調查，因為葛帔尼亞很容易進入。

scripts.text: The request starts from how to find a way in. Please take a look what kind of monsters are in there. first of all, start by hunting ^FF000010^000000 Incubus, Succubus and Violy. Then lets research the details later.
scripts.translation: 這份委託從尋找入口開始。先去看看裡面有哪些魔物。首先狩獵^FF000010^000000只惡魔侍者、惡魔女僕和薇歐莉，之後再詳細研究。

scripts.text: Try to start from Geffen fountain, if you want more information.
scripts.translation: 想了解更多的話，可以從吉芬噴泉附近開始找。

scripts.text: They all look the same for me.	I should research harder.
scripts.translation: 在我看來它們都長得一樣...我得更努力研究才行。

scripts.text: There is one more reason why many adventurers are sent to Juperos and that is my real request.
scripts.translation: 冒險者被派往尤佩羅還有另一個原因，那才是我真正的委託。

scripts.text: If you go to Juperos? I wish you to take a request about ^FF0000Venatus^000000.
scripts.translation: 要去尤佩羅嗎？我想請你接下關於^FF0000凡娜圖^000000的委託。

scripts.text: You are not confused? I still do not know yet. What is the difference? Anyway good job.
scripts.translation: 你不覺得困惑嗎？我也還不知道它們有什麼區別。總之，幹得好。

scripts.text: The remains of ancient, Juperos is mysterious. There are lots of ^FF0000secrets^000000. But this is yet again a simple monster research survey.
scripts.translation: 古老的尤佩羅遺蹟充滿神秘，藏著許多^FF0000秘密^000000。儘管如此，這仍只是一項簡單的魔物調查。

scripts.text: The monster ^FF0000Venatu^000000 in juperos has 4 types of colors. Which means there are four types of monsters.
scripts.translation: 尤佩羅的^FF0000凡娜圖^000000有四種顏色，也就是說有四種不同的魔物。

scripts.text: I thought they are the same because they look the same. Is it only me? I can not distinguish. Hunt 30 of each Green, Orange and Blue ones just to be sure.
scripts.translation: 它們長得一樣，我還以為是同一種。難道只有我分不出來？為了確認，請分別狩獵30只綠色、橙色和藍色的。

scripts.text: It wil not be easy to be alone. But looking for a fellow for adventure is what an adventurer does.
scripts.translation: 一個人行動當然不容易，不過尋找冒險夥伴也是冒險者該做的事。

scripts.text: I will make anything better than you imagine.
scripts.translation: 我會做出超乎你想像的成果。

scripts.text: Thank you. You will appreciate me if my research is completed.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你。等我的研究完成，你一定會認可我的。

scripts.text: You can find ^FF0000Fragment and Rusty Screw^000000 in juperos everywhere. Most of the monsters have it.
scripts.translation: 尤佩羅到處都有^FF0000碎片和生鏽的螺絲^000000。大多數魔物身上都有。

scripts.text: I know it is not easy but I wish thee to take this request. Please.
scripts.translation: 我知道這不容易，但還是希望你能接下這份委託。拜託了。

scripts.text: Juperos is intense and mysterious. When he showed up, It seems like it is not Midgard.
scripts.translation: 尤佩羅氣氛緊張又神秘。那傢伙出現時，感覺這裡不像米德加爾特。

scripts.text: It is core research. I need to know who he is. That will be amazing. Can you bring me 10 ^FF0000Fragment^000000 and 20 ^FF0000Rusty Screw^000000?
scripts.translation: 這是核心研究，我得弄清楚那傢伙究竟是什麼，肯定很有意思。能帶回10個^FF0000碎片^000000和20個^FF0000生鏽的螺絲^000000嗎？

scripts.text: I do not know how many drops you can carry but I want as many as you can. May I ask you to bring 10 ^FF0000Fragment^000000 and 20 ^FF0000Rusty Screw^000000?
scripts.translation: 我不知道你能帶多少戰利品，但希望越多越好。能帶回10個^FF0000碎片^000000和20個^FF0000生鏽的螺絲^000000嗎？

scripts.text: The request for researching monsters seem to easy for you.
scripts.translation: 研究魔物的委託對你來說似乎太簡單了。

scripts.text: There is nothing I can do because these are the rules of the Eden Group.
scripts.translation: 這是樂園團的規矩，我也無能為力。

scripts.text: There is someone who strongly wishes you to solve your request.
scripts.translation: 有人非常希望你完成這份委託。

scripts.text: Contract is terminated. {0} reward for completed research. ^FF0000I will delete incompleted research from your quest list.^000000
scripts.translation: 合同終止。完成研究後可獲得{0}獎勵。^FF0000我會從你的任務列表中刪除尚未完成的研究委託。^000000

scripts.text: It is a little bit inconvenient. I will read to you politely ^FF0000again^000000 in public.
scripts.translation: 有點不方便。我會在公開場合再次^FF0000禮貌地^000000讀給你聽。

scripts.text: Anyway {0} thank you for helping me start my research.
scripts.translation: 總之，{0}，謝謝你幫我開始研究。

scripts.text: Do not worry, I will treat you like a slave if we meet outside of Eden Group or if you tell anyone I was nice to you.
scripts.translation: 別擔心。如果在樂園團外遇見，或者你告訴別人我對你很客氣，我就會把你當奴隸使喚。

scripts.text: Just because I'm being nice now doesn't mean we're automatically friends though.
scripts.translation: 不過，我現在對你好，也不代表我們就成了朋友。

scripts.text: Do you want to know something? I am busy researching.
scripts.translation: 想知道一件事嗎？我正忙著研究。

scripts.text: It is fine day for researching. It is always fun to talk to someone of sufficient intelligence.
scripts.translation: 今天真適合做研究。和聰明人交談總是很愉快。

scripts.text: I found a familiar face since I arrived to Eden Group with this request. ^ff0000Rohtert^000000 is the one.
scripts.translation: 我帶著這份委託來到樂園團後，發現了一位熟人。那個人就是^ff0000羅特特^000000。

scripts.text: I used to join clubs that researched rare monsters. I heard it became a guild and anyway I met him there.
scripts.translation: 我以前參加過研究稀有魔物的俱樂部。聽說後來它變成了公會，我就是在那裡認識他的。

scripts.text: I look younger but I am like his sister. There was so many things that happened in that club. However, I shouldn't go on and on about it. I might tell you later when we have time.
scripts.translation: 我看起來比較年輕，不過就像他的姐姐一樣。那個俱樂部發生過很多事。不過我不該一直說個不停，有空再告訴你吧。

scripts.text: I found a familiar face since I arrived to Eden Group with this request. Do you see the guy ^FF0000Rohtert^000000 with white hair near the entrance?
scripts.translation: 我帶著這份委託來到樂園團後，發現了一位熟人。看到入口附近那個白頭髮的傢伙了嗎？他就是^FF0000羅特特^000000。

scripts.text: Now that he's grown up... well he used to follow me calling me his sister. By the way where is the blue hat guy who used to stick to him like glue. Did they have a fight?
scripts.translation: 他現在長大了...以前總跟在我身後叫我姐姐。對了，那個總黏著他的藍帽子傢伙去哪兒了？他們吵架了嗎？

scripts.text: That blue hat guy... He used to annoy me even at the club. If I see him again I just might smack him...
scripts.translation: 那個藍帽子傢伙...以前在俱樂部時就很煩人。要是再讓我碰見他，我可能會揍他一頓...

scripts.text: I used to talk to Rohtert from time to time while researching. There was a lot of things to talk about ever since I left the guild.
scripts.translation: 我以前研究時常和羅特特聊天。自從離開公會後，我們有很多話題。

scripts.text: I think the guild is still around since there were so many members even when I was there.
scripts.translation: 我在公會時成員很多，所以我想它現在應該還在。

scripts.text: I even heard that blue hat guy made himself a guild master. Imagine that fool being a master oh ho ho ho.
scripts.translation: 我還聽說那個藍帽子傢伙當上了公會會長。那個笨蛋居然當會長，呵呵呵。

scripts.text: I research monsters. Especially their features, personality, spleens, locations and relationship with other monsters. Etc.
scripts.translation: 我研究魔物，尤其是它們的特徵、性格、內臟、棲息地，以及彼此間的關係等等。

scripts.text: Researching these magic items there is more to it than just having them in your possession.
scripts.translation: 研究這些魔法物品，可不只是把它們拿在手裡那麼簡單。

scripts.text: My plan so far is like this. Extracted magic from the Mystic Horn is compressed by the Fragments and Screws. Then I will input the ancient information which was written in the Bloody Pages.
scripts.translation: 我目前的計劃是這樣：先用碎片和螺絲壓縮魔力之角提取的魔力，再輸入染血的書頁上記載的古代資訊。

scripts.text: I'm hoping to create some type of small hand-held storage device.
scripts.translation: 我希望能製造出某種小型的手持儲存裝置。

scripts.text: I wil be rich if I complete this research! I am sure.
scripts.translation: 這項研究完成後我就發財了！肯定沒錯。

scripts.text: Well do you remember my personal research I mentioned before? It is not easy even I tried to develop...
scripts.translation: 還記得我之前提到的個人研究嗎？我試著開發了很久，還是不容易...

scripts.text: I tried to make a magic device that you can hold in your hand.
scripts.translation: 我試著製造一種可以拿在手裡的魔法裝置。

scripts.text: No. I can not give up for this. I will make it.
scripts.translation: 不，我不能放棄。我一定會做出來。

scripts.text: Orange mushroom? I do not know.
Do not worry. Ok, maybe worry because mushrooms could be growing in your body. I will get rid of it if you help me to research. It will be dangerous if it takes longer time.
scripts.translation: 別擔心。好吧，也許你該擔心，因為蘑菇可能會在你體內生長。只要你幫我研究，我就會想辦法清除。拖太久可就危險了。

scripts.text: Let me see. It might be dangerous.
You helped me to research so let me help you! I will get rid of your mushroom spore infection.
scripts.translation: 你幫我做了研究，所以讓我也幫幫你！我會清除你身上的蘑菇孢子感染。

scripts.text: Hmmph, You are so naive. Did you believe it? Sticky.. some kind of mushroom is growing in your body? Hahaha
scripts.translation: 哼，你真天真。你信了嗎？黏黏的...什麼蘑菇正在你身體裡生長？哈哈哈。

scripts.text: It was just a joke. A little joke between friends.
scripts.translation: 只是開個玩笑，朋友間的小玩笑。

scripts.text: I am sorry if you are upset. You made it too easy...
scripts.translation: 如果你不高興，我很抱歉。是你自己太容易上當了...

scripts.text: You are funnier than I thought. Do not worry. That mushroom does not exist.
scripts.translation: 你比我想的有趣。別擔心，那種蘑菇根本不存在。

scripts.text: Please help me there are so many things to research.
scripts.translation: 請幫幫我，還有很多東西要研究。
